title: Director of Responsible AI
description: Director, AI Governance - IAA06AE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Director of Responsible AI will help to lead the responsible development, implementation, and use of Artificial Intelligence across the enterprise. This role will serve as a key member of the AI Governance function, partnering with business leaders, data scientists, engineers, Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management to ensure AI solutions are designed, deployed, and monitored in a manner consistent with The Hartford's values, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations. The Director will provide oversight and consultation throughout the AI lifecycle, driving responsible AI practices to enable innovative use of AI technologies that deliver measurable business value. Key Responsibilities: Responsible AI Governance: Facilitate governance reviews of AI and Generative AI use cases to identify, assess, and communicate AI risks both from an inherent and residual perspective. Review and interpret AI risk assessments, fairness testing results, model evaluations, monitoring outcomes, and other control evidence to assess solution readiness and ongoing effectiveness. Support development and enhancement of governance frameworks, standards, and procedures that enable scalable and effective AI oversight. Consultation & Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders on Responsible AI development, governance expectations, and emerging regulatory considerations. Promote practical governance approaches that balance risk management with innovation and business value creation. Emerging Governance and Controls: Evaluate governance implications of advanced AI capabilities, including Generative AI, reusable AI components, foundation models, and agentic AI systems. Influence governance strategies and control approaches for emerging technologies, including monitoring, intervention, containment, and shutoff mechanisms for autonomous and semi-autonomous systems. Lead the development of or the review for enterprise controls to mitigate AI risks. Required Qualifications: 10+ years of experience in quantitative science, statistics, data science, AI/ML development, actuarial science, or related discipline. 2+ years of experience developing, deploying, or governing Generative AI solutions. 1+ years of experience providing consultation, training, teaching, coaching, or advisory services. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts to business, risk, and executive stakeholders. Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, Responsible AI principles, and associated governance challenges. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working within governance, risk management, controls, compliance, model risk management, or internal audit functions. Experience designing or supporting reusable AI, analytics, or machine learning components and platforms. Experience governing or developing agentic AI systems and familiarity with emerging control approaches, including model context protocols (MCP), monitoring frameworks, intervention controls, human oversight mechanisms, and system shutdown capabilities. Experience within financial services, insurance, or another highly regulated industry. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, model risk management practices, fairness testing methodologies, and regulatory expectations for AI systems. Key Competencies: Responsible AI governance expertise Risk assessment and control evaluation Cross-functional stakeholder management Executive communication and presentation skills Quantitative and analytical problem solving Regulatory and compliance awareness Technology-to-business translation Continuous learning and innovation mindset Work Arrangement: This role may have a hybrid work arrangement. Candidates located near one of our office locations (Hartford, CT or Chicago, IL) may be expected to work in the office multiple days per week. Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work arrangement, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship. Compensation The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $144,000 - $216,000 Equal Op

title: AI Governance (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d)
description: YOUR TASKS You analyze existing governance models and identify optimization potential in the context of AI. Additionally at Senior Level: You lead complex governance projects, assume strategic responsibility for the implementation of modern AI governance frameworks, and advise organizations on governance, risk, and compliance topics at the enterprise level. You design and implement policies, procedures, and frameworks to ensure robust AI governance. Additionally at Senior Level: You develop tailored governance strategies and solutions aligned with international compliance and ethical standards and advise on establishing new processes, committees, and clear accountability structures. You support clients nationally and internationally in establishing compliance and ethical standards. Additionally at Senior Level: You advise executives and decision-makers on regulatory risks and support organizations in preparing for the EU AI Act, including integrating its requirements into existing processes, structures, and control systems. You coordinate the implementation of governance processes within AI projects. Additionally at Senior Level: You oversee the implementation of governance processes, initiate continuous improvements, and collaborate closely with internal teams and clients, particularly in regulated industries. You assess regulatory requirements and derive measures to ensure compliance with applicable legal frameworks. Additionally at Senior Level: You support the implementation and further development of ISO management systems and conduct or professionally accompany information security audits. You mentor and coach junior consultants and foster knowledge transfer within the team. You document processes and prepare reports to continuously improve governance structures. Additionally at Senior Level: You document project progress, present results in workshops, lead strategic discussions with stakeholders, and prepare well-founded decision materials. YOUR PROFIL You have successfully completed your studies and bring initial relevant practical experience, for example through internships or working student positions. Additionally at Senior Level: You have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, ideally in consulting, auditing, or a comparable role. You are passionate about topics such as governance or risk & compliance and have a solid theoretical foundation. Additionally at Senior Level: You bring extensive experience in regulation, governance, or risk & compliance. You have a basic understanding of how AI models function and are interested in their governance and quality assurance. Additionally at Senior Level: You possess solid experience in cross-functional consulting on the design of AI control processes and in ensuring governance standards throughout the entire AI lifecycle. You are highly motivated to explore frameworks for the safe use of AI and are interested in regulatory environments. Additionally at Senior Level: You have knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, or MaRisk and ideally the EU AI Act, or you are willing to quickly and thoroughly develop expertise in this area. You have basic knowledge of information security and ideally have gained initial insights into audit processes. Additionally at Senior Level: You have auditing experience, particularly in the field of information security, and ideally hold a certification as an ISO Lead Implementor and/or ISO Auditor. You have the ability to understand complex requirements and enjoy translating them into practical measures. Additionally at Senior Level: You are able to confidently assess regulatory requirements, interpret them pragmatically, and translate them into concrete organizational, procedural, or technical measures. You enjoy working in a team, take initiative, and are open to feedback and continuous development. Additionally at Senior Level: You take an active role within the team, foster professional exchange, and support the development of others. Initiative, ownership, and a reflective approach to feedback are natural for you. You have strong communication skills and are confident communicating in both German and English. Additionally at Senior Level: You communicate confidently in German and English, including with senior stakeholders. YOUR BENEFITS Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace. Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work. Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level. Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows). Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office. Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Data Protection & AI Governance Advisor (m/w/d)
description: Your mission Datenschutz Du unterstützt unsere Business Funktionen bei der Dokumentation ihrer Verarbeitungsprozessen und pflegst die Verzeichnisse nach Art. 30 Abs. 1 + 2 DSGVO. Du erstellst Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments. Du berätst die Fachbereiche zur datenschutzrechtlichen Ausgestaltung unserer SaaS-Produkte und internen Prozesse – insbesondere zu Datenminimierung, Mandantentrennung, Berechtigungskonzepten, Löschung und Privacy by Design. Du prüfst Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge und führst Vorabprüfungen neuer Dienstleister und KI-Tools durch. Du betreibst das Datenschutzmanagementsystem: Du pflegst Richtlinien und Vorlagen, führst Kontrollen durch, überwachst Abhilfemaßnahmen und verwaltest unsere Datenschutz- und KI-Governanceplattform. AI Governance Du baust das Inventar unserer KI-Systeme auf und pflegst es, bereitest die Einordnung nach Art. 6 und Anhang III AI Act vor und bestimmst unsere Rolle als Anbieter oder Betreiber. Du wirkst am Freigabeprozess für KI-Vorhaben mit und entwickelst Prüfkriterien, Gates und Entscheidungsvorlagen. Du erstellst die Pflichtdokumentation zu Risikomanagement, Daten-Governance und Bias-Prüfung, technischer Dokumentation, menschlicher Aufsicht, Protokollierung sowie Transparenzpflichten. Du prüfst KI-Modelle und -Dienste auf vertragliche Zusagen zu Trainingsnutzung, Datenhaltung und Vereinbarkeit mit unseren Kundenzusagen. So arbeiten wir zusammen Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, das pragmatisch denkt und eng mit Produkt, Engineering und Legal zusammenarbeitet. Wir schätzen offenen Austausch, kurze Wege und die gemeinsame Freude daran, komplexe Regulatorik in praktikable Lösungen zu übersetzen. Your profile Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Datenschutz mit, davon substanziell in einer Second-Line-Funktion – etwa als Datenschutzkoordinator, im Datenschutzmanagement, in einer Compliance- oder Governance-Einheit oder in einer externen Beratungsrolle mit vergleichbarem Prüfauftrag. Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments. Du gehst sicher mit der DSGVO auf Normebene um, kennst die EDSA-Leitlinien und bist vertraut mit der Rechtsprechung zu Drittlandtransfers und Verantwortlichkeit. Du hast erste belegbare Berührungspunkte mit KI-Governance und dem EU AI Act – etwa durch Klassifizierung von KI-Systemen, Bewertung von LLM-gestützten Funktionen, Modell- oder Bias-Prüfungen, Erstellung von Transparenzhinweisen oder Mitarbeit an einer KI-Richtlinie. Du musst keine vollständige AI-Act-Routine mitbringen; die Bereitschaft, dir diese Tiefe bei uns aufzubauen, genügt uns. Du arbeitest strukturiert und verlässlich mit hoher Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher. Wünschenswert: Du hast ein juristisches Studium abgeschlossen sowie eine Zertifizierung wie etwa IAPP CIPP/E, CIPM oder AIGP erworben. Für Juristinnen und Juristen: Du strebst eine Zulassung als Syndikusrechtsanwältin oder Syndikusrechtsanwalt an? Wir unterstützen dich aktiv dabei – sowohl im Zulassungsverfahren als auch bei der fachlichen Ausgestaltung deiner Rolle. Why us Weil wir Talent höher bewerten als Hierarchien. Weil Verantwortung bei uns nicht delegiert, sondern übernommen wird. Weil wir moderne KI und Technologie als Hebel für außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse nutzen. Weil wir Menschen fördern, die lernen, wachsen und liefern wollen. Weil Leistung, Qualität und Impact bei uns untrennbar zusammengehören. Weil wir gemeinsam daran arbeiten, einen europäischen Tech-Champion aufzubauen. What You Can Expect Leistungsorientierte, überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, die herausragenden Einsatz honoriert. High-End-Offices, die Zusammenarbeit, Gesundheit und Bestleistung fördern - inklusive attraktiver Gesundheits- und Fitnessangebote. Legendäre Team Events, bei denen wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern und unseren Zusammenhalt stärken. Modernste KI-Tools, erstklassige Arbeitsmittel und ein Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung und persönliches Wachstum fördert. Hohe Talentdichte, schnelle Entscheidungen und die Chance, früh echten Einfluss zu übernehmen. title: Subject Matter Expert, GTM GRC - Revenue
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Compliance and trust are the products we sell — which means the people who understand GRC most deeply sit at the center of how we win. The GTM GRC SME team brings Governance, Risk, and Compliance expertise directly into customer conversations where it materially improves qualification, solution confidence, stakeholder alignment, and post-sale success. This is not a back-office compliance role and it is not a generic sales-engineering role. You will operate as a named member of deal teams under our pod model: paired with Strategic and Enterprise Account Executives, embedded in their weekly cadences, engaged from first discovery through POC, onsite, close, and expansion. You will be the practitioner in the room that a buyer's CISO or GRC lead trusts — and the internal expert our AEs, SEs, and marketing team build around. What you’ll do as a Subject Matter Expert, GTM at Vanta: - Serve as the dedicated GRC SME for a book of Strategic/Enterprise Account Executives: join discovery and qualification calls at the earliest deal stages, scope compliance programs against Vanta's platform, and support demos, POCs, workshops, and customer onsites across Compliance, Third-Party Risk Management, Risk Management, and Trust/Questionnaire Automation. - Advise prospects on program architecture: multi-framework strategy, shared controls, business-unit and workspace scoping, custom frameworks, and audit sequencing. - Answer field questions through our SME channels at customer-forwardable quality — including reviewing and validating AI-agent-generated answers before they reach customers. Our team runs AI-first: you'll use agents daily, act as the quality gate on their output, and (ideally) build tooling of your own. - Design and deliver enablement: live sessions for GTM teams, bootcamp scenarios and mock-customer roleplay, async curriculum modules, and review of GRC marketing and SEO content. - Own monthly alignment cadences with sales front-line managers; feed structured product feedback to our Product and PM partners; carry deal context cleanly into post-sales handoffs. - Travel roughly once per quarter (a few days to a week) for customer onsites, POC workshops, team offsites, and events. Domain coverage. We hire T-shaped practitioners: deep in two to three of the following pillars, conversant and demo-capable across all nine — Governance · Data Governance · Compliance · Risk Management (IT, Security, and Enterprise) · Third-Party Risk Management · Continuous Monitoring · Privacy · Trust · AI Security & Governance. How to be successful in this role: - 5+ years of hands-on GRC experience, with buyer-side depth: you've built, run, or transformed a multi-framework compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701, HIPAA/HITRUST, PCI DSS 4.0, GDPR and the US privacy patchwork, NIST CSF 2.0), or advised many organizations doing so. - Working fluency in at least one emerging area — AI governance (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF), GRC engineering / continuous monitoring, or enterprise risk — and genuine curiosity about the rest. - Evidence of customer-facing range: you're credible with a skeptical CISO, a first-time founder, and a procurement team in the same week, and you enjoy the thrill of winning deals. - Production-quality writing: answers, scoping docs, and playbooks that can go to a customer on first draft. - Demonstrated AI fluency: you use LLM tooling in your compliance work today, can judge AI output against authoritative sources, and want to build with it. - Teaching ability: you've trained, presented, published, or enabled others, and you're comfortable building and delivering a session to a large GTM audience. - Sales-process literacy (MEDDPICC or similar), audit-process depth from either side of the table, and the judgment to hold scope boundaries gracefully under deal pressure. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. - Certifications (CISSP, CISA/CISM, ISO 27001 LA/LI, CIPP/CIPT, AI-governance credentials) are welcome signals, not gates. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office - Family planning benefits - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting - Flexibl

title: Field Security Advisor
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.   About the Role We have created a new standard in cyber extortion incident response and are expanding our Cyber Readiness & Advisory Services team to continue evolving the retained client experience. We are looking for a Field Security Advisor to help us develop and deliver valuable content, tabletop exercises, and training workshops to our enterprise customers. In this role, you will work closely with our Customer Success team and Field CISO organization to help Global 2000 customers prepare executive, technical, finance, legal, and operational teams for the realities of handling a cyber extortion incident and improving organizational resiliency. Coveware is a fully distributed company with employees across multiple geographies. This is a remote role with global time zone flexibility. Candidates may be based in any geography as long as they can provide reliable overlap with customer time zones and travel periodically for customer on-sites and events. This is an individual contributor role. The role reports to the Senior Director, Field CISO within the Cyber Readiness and Advisory Services team. What You'll Do Deliver cyber extortion readiness engagements for retained enterprise customers, including executive briefings, technical workshops, and cross-functional training sessions. Design and facilitate tabletop exercises that reflect realistic cyber extortion conditions, operational disruption, ambiguous early facts, and executive decision points. Curate and continuously improve customer-facing content, including playbooks, decision frameworks, readiness checklists, and workshop materials, keeping deliverables aligned to current ransomware/extortion patterns. Conduct research and forensic data analysis to support advisory deliverables and customer insights, including synthesizing lessons learned from case trends and interpreting forensic outputs/artifacts (as available) into clear, actionable readiness recommendations. Support the customer lifecycle as needed, including customer due diligence requests, RFP/RFI questionnaires, and review of contracts/security exhibits in partnership with internal stakeholders. Collaborate internally with case management, SMEs, and other stakeholders to ensure readiness guidance stays grounded in real-world incident behavior and recovery constraints. Technologies You'll Work With Incident Response / Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) tools and methodologies Security Operations platforms and processes Cybersecurity advisory and consulting frameworks MITRE ATT&CK NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) CIS Controls Forensic analysis tools and artifacts Ransomware and cyber extortion readiness frameworks What You'll Bring 7+ years of experience in information security/cybersecurity, with depth in one or more of: Incident response / DFIR Security operations Cyber risk / security advisory / consulting 3+ years of customer-facing experience supporting B2B enterprise customers in advisory, incident readiness, cybersecurity, technology, or forensics-related services. Foundational knowledge of application, identity, cloud and network security concepts, and incident response best practices, ideally in a Global 2000 enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience presenting in a consultative manner to enterprise leadership and facilitating educational workshops and tabletop exercises. Ability to communicate complex topics clearly and authoritatively to diverse audiences, orally and in writing. Willingness and ability to travel for customer meetings, workshops, and events on occasion. Comfortable leading discussions with enterprise stakeholders across both technical and executive teams. Consultative/advisory mindset with structured problem framing, strong facilitation skills, crisp communication, and defensible recommendations. Strong listening skills with excellent written and verbal communication skills and willingness to deliver hard truths when needed to surface gaps and drive improvement. Strong, structured writing skills with experience producing executive-ready, evidence-based deliverables, translating complex inputs into clear narratives, prioritized recommendations, and defensible documentation. Bonus Skills One or more information security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, GCIH, GCFE, GCFA). Bachelor’s degre
